entities.summary: BNS Khalid Bin Walid is a guided-missile frigate of the Bangladesh Navy. It is currently based at Chittagong, serving with the Commodore Commanding BN Flotilla (COMBAN). It is currently the only frigate of the Bangladesh Navy armed with ASW torpedo and gun based CIWS. It is named after the Muslim general Khalid Bin Walid.
